component.name: MonoChat
component.summary: Keep independent messaging accounts in one window
Niezależne konta komunikatorów w jednym oknie

description.p: MonoChat is an independent Linux application that embeds the official web interfaces of WhatsApp, Messenger, Google Messages and Instagram Direct. Each account has a separate persistent browser session.
Use named accounts, pause a service, mute audio and manage local sessions. No MonoChat account or cloud server is required.
Initial development version. Anonymous login screens and isolated sessions tested. Authenticated messaging acceptance is pending.
